summary: Tested new P1 features on /plan (PlanTakeoff) as Pro user with existing testplan.png. All 4 features work: fullscreen toggle, contrast/brightness sliders + reset, manual save with PATCH /api/takeoffs/{id}/annotations returning 200 and toast 'Plan enregistré'. No blocking JS console errors during interactions.

detailed_verifications.login_and_navigation: Login as pro@construpilot.fr OK, token stored in localStorage('construpilot_token'), navigation to /plan OK, plan card 'testplan.png' visible and clickable.
detailed_verifications.toolbar_testids_present: tool-fullscreen(1), tool-img-adjust(1), plan-save-btn(1), autosave-status(1), plan-canvas-surface(1), plan-canvas(1) — all found.
detailed_verifications.fullscreen: Click tool-fullscreen -> plan-canvas-surface bbox becomes {x:0,y:0,width:1920,height:1080} (fixed full viewport). Button label switches to 'Quitter'. Escape key exits: bbox returns to normal container size, label back to 'Plein écran'. Canvas remains visible in both states.
detailed_verifications.contrast_panel: img-adjust-panel opens on click. Setting contrast slider to 1.8 displays '125%' text update; brightness slider works too. Reset button restores both to 100%. No JS errors from filter application.
detailed_verifications.save: Click plan-save-btn triggers PATCH https://.../api/takeoffs/plan_9324dac7ece6/annotations -> 200. Green toast 'Plan enregistré' shown. autosave-status badge visible.

critical_code_review_comments: PlanTakeoff.jsx is ~2900+ lines — heavily oversized. Should be split into subcomponents (toolbar, side panel, canvas wrapper, adjust panel) for maintainability. Not blocking for this P1 test but flagged for future refactor.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P1 features on /plan verified end-to-end. If retesting, be aware that PATCH /api/takeoffs/{plan_id}/annotations is the manual save endpoint and returns 200. Fullscreen sets plan-canvas-surface to fixed position covering viewport; Escape exits.
